name: sol-advisor
description: Native Codex workflow for selective functional subagents, isolated primary context, and bounded evidence verification.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work without polluting primary context.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor selectively routes functional custom agents only when bounded delegation can improve primary-context isolation or task accuracy. Children own exclusive discovery, long-context analysis, sufficiently large deterministic edits, independent verification, or evidence adjudication until one compressed final result returns. The primary session owns complex implementation, bounded evidence checks, fallback, and final integration.
defaultPrompt: Handle this repository task and delegate only when a bounded child has clear context or quality benefit.
Keep complex implementation in the primary session; while a child works, do not duplicate its question or source scope.
Read one native final result, verify only decisive evidence, allow one targeted correction, then fall back.
